## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad equity indices are BELOW TREND — SPY (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -1.62% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND — while commodity pockets (USO, BNO, UGA) are ABOVE TREND, producing offsetting signals; VXX RECOVERY (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -5.49%) shows a short-term volatility bounce.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit conditions tilting tighter: HYG (1W: -0.71% | 1M: -0.95%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.82% | 1M: -0.77%) BELOW TREND are down. Commodity-driven cyclical pockets (BNO (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +18.74%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +19.86%) ABOVE TREND) are supporting risk in places, while equity breadth remains narrow.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tighter: TLT (1W: -1.04% | 1M: -0.20%) BELOW TREND and weak HYG/LQD suggest modestly tighter conditions; dollar and core macro ratios show no clear directional bias (flat / NEUTRAL).

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Defensive pockets showing resilience: XLP (1W: +0.34% | 1M: -1.59%) RECOVERY and Healthcare (sector: 1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.88%) are positive this week. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -2.10% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND; style: defensive/quality bias rather than growth leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US indices soft: SPY (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND and IWM (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -6.38%) BELOW TREND. EM and China weak: EEM (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -2.38%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: -1.82% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND; Japan showing minor stabilization: EWJ (1W: +0.01% | 1M: -1.18%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed: IBIT (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +18.18%) CORRECTION and ETHA (1W: -2.31% | 1M: +26.04%) CORRECTION show strong 1M gains but short-term pullbacks; small caps and cyclical beta are retreating — IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -6.38%).

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity strength concentrated in energy and ags: UGA (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +18.05%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +19.86%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +18.74%) ABOVE TREND; base/industrial metals weak — CPER (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -3.84%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Mixed but tilted up: XLE (1W: -1.96% | 1M: +2.32%) CORRECTION while BNO (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +18.74%) ABOVE TREND and UNG (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +5.39%) ABOVE TREND show strength across oil and gas.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: broad equity softness — SPY (1W: -1.10% | 1M: -2.41%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -1.62% | 1M: -3.45%) BELOW TREND. DIVERGENCE: commodity and crypto 1M strength vs 1W pullbacks — IBIT (1W: -2.82% | 1M: +18.18%) CORRECTION, ETHA (1W: -2.31% | 1M: +26.04%) CORRECTION — a selective rather than broad risk environment.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor selective commodity and defensive exposures: BNO (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +18.74%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +19.86%) ABOVE TREND, XLP (1W: +0.34% | 1M: -1.59%) RECOVERY; reduce exposure to broad beta and growth momentum while monitoring IBIT and ETHA for mean reversion.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy/agriculture — BNO (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +18.74%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +19.86%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Tech and industrials — XLK (1W: -2.10% | 1M: -3.36%) BELOW TREND, XLI (1W: -1.79% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil and nat gas — USO (1W: +4.13% | 1M: +19.86%) ABOVE TREND, UNG (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +5.39%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper/metals — CPER (1W: -5.99% | 1M: -3.84%) BELOW TREND; precious metals soft — GLD (1W: -2.88% | 1M: -3.39%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
Watch VXX ~20 (volatility trigger for risk sentiment); monitor HYG/LQD spread (falling HYG/LQD → credit stress); XLK/XLV leadership pivot (XLK below trend vs Healthcare resilience) as a growth vs defensive inflection.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; narrow market breadth and major indices BELOW TREND counterbalance strong commodity pockets. Commodities and defensive sectors showing relative strength while tech and small caps show weakness — monitor crypto/commodity 1M vs 1W divergences (IBIT, ETHA) as the primary risk for a directional breakout.
